name: R3:STORE
summary:
Super Intelligent AI has been achieved and thus WW3 has ended! The last of humanity has decided to live underground in neural hookups, allowing them to interface with a specially made intranet. 

However, sacrificing your autonomy for a computer interface controlled by a corporation is never a good idea!

Humanity may still live, but democracy has definitely died. 

GroundWorks Inc. , the company that made the pods, also controls the intranet, enforcing censorship on what people hear, see, and do.
